name: Zhejiang Jihua Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Jihua Group Co., Ltd. produces and sells dyes, dye intermediates, and other chemical products. The company offers dyes and reactive dyes, including 2,4-dinitroaniline and intermediate H acid. It also provides non-stick coatings, polyurethane foam, and other chemical products. In addition, the company engages in import and export trade; production and sales of water-based coatings; and research, development, and transfer of pharmaceutical technology. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
